name: Onesource Industries and Ventures Limited
about: Onesource Industries and Ventures Limited engage in the trading of agricultural commodities in India. The company trades in rice, pulses, food grains, and allied products. It also exports its products. The company serves consumers in the urban and rural areas. The company was formerly known as Onesource Ideas Venture Limited and changed its name to Onesource Industries and Ventures Limited in September 2024. Onesource Industries and Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Bhopal, India.
